description: Unique simulated user identifier.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Final approved scenario assigned and actually scheduled for this user.
calculation: Unique scheduled scenario_id for the user.
notes: May differ from preliminary Stage 2 assignment. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Scheduled attack stealth category: High, Medium or Low.
calculation: Lookup final scenario in approved catalog.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Beginning of validated scheduled attack window.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: End of validated scheduled attack window.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Number of eligible scheduled workdays including Off days.
notes: Do not interpret as total calendar days. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Number of scheduled days with one or more successfully injected channels.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Number of scheduled days intentionally left without injection.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Number of validated scheduled primary-channel changes across active days, ignoring Off days.
calculation: COUNT(primary_channel change between consecutive active scheduled days).
notes: Describes scheduled primary channel, not observed dominant-channel feature. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Total number of additional synthetic channel activity counts assigned to this user.
notes: Not transferred bytes or reconstructed raw events. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Name of the selected synthetic injection rule.
notes: max(1, ceil(natural_count * stealth_multiplier)). Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Distinguishes simulated labels from official CERT malicious-user annotations.
notes: Different from official CERT Ground Truth for five excluded original malicious users. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Simulated user associated with injected channel-day.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Eligible workday of channel-level synthetic injection.
calculation: Scheduled day normalized to calendar date.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Injected channel: email, usb or http (lowercase).
calculation: Expand planned channel selection from attack_channels for active days.
notes: One row per user+day+channel; no raw event_id. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Final scheduled scenario identifier for this injection.
calculation: From validated schedule; checked against approved catalog.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Stealth level for the user scenario.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Original activity count for this user, day and channel, before synthetic injection.
calculation: Email: external_email_count; USB: usb_copy_count; HTTP: www_upload_count.
notes: Must be positive for planned channels. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Pre-2011 positive-active-day historical P95 for this user and channel.
calculation: Email email_count_p95; USB usb_copy_p95; HTTP http_upload_p95.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Multiplier used for the final Formula B event addition.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Positive additional synthetic activity count for the scheduled channel-day.
notes: One aggregate increment, not separately timestamped synthetic events. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Activity count after approved Formula B addition.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Selected quantity-generation formula.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: User identifier.
notes: Join to features using user + day. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Eligible workday.
calculation: Original User-Day date after eligibility filtering.
notes: Join to features using user + day. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Assigned final scenario for this user, repeated even on days outside the attack window.
notes: Not evidence injection occurred on this date. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: User scenario stealth label, present on all eligible user-days.
notes: Not safe to use as a predictor. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Three-way status: Attack / Off / Outside Schedule.
calculation: If injected_events_total>0 then Attack; else if is_scheduled=1 then Off; else Outside Schedule.
notes: Attack = positive synthetic injection; Off = scheduled day without injection; Outside Schedule = no injection and outside scenario window. These do not certify all non-injected activity benign. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Whether the user-day belongs to the validated attack window.
calculation: 1 if user+day found in validated schedule, else 0.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: 1 if one or more positive synthetic channel injections occurred, else 0.
notes: This is the binary target for synthetic injection detection, not a predictor. Attack = positive synthetic injection; Off = scheduled day without injection; Outside Schedule = no injection and outside scenario window. These do not certify all non-injected activity benign.

description: Number of channels scheduled for injection on this day (0..3).
calculation: Join schedule value for that day; 0 if outside schedule.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Number of distinct Email/USB/HTTP channels with positive synthetic increments on that day.
calculation: COUNT(DISTINCT channel) over positive channel-day increments; 0 otherwise.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Number of synthetic Email events added that day.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Number of synthetic USB copy events added that day.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Number of synthetic HTTP upload events added that day.
notes: Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.

description: Total synthetic added event counts over all three channels in this user-day.
notes: Exactly 0 for Off and Outside Schedule. Ground Truth metadata/label: join or audit only; never include as ML predictors.
